'''Saganu''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] of [[House Miurani]] during the [[Galactic War]] between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Saganu served as the [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] of [[House Miurani]] and as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] in [[3642 BBY]], at the start of the [[Galactic War]] between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Occasionally, he performed diplomatic duties for the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. During the war, Chiss troops were stationed on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] to help the Sith Empire to seize the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from the Republic. Saganu also provided assistance to the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] before it was disbanded that year, although it was hidden from official records.<ref name="Codex" />

On Hoth, he was stationed at the outpost called [[Zero Station]] where he supervised his people and [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] [[Raina Temple]] in their efforts to aid their [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] allies against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Together, Saganu and Temple aided the Imperial Intelligence agent [[Cipher Nine]] in tracking down rogue Imperial [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Layek Davos]] across Hoth's frozen surface.<ref name="Frigid Expedition">{{TORcite|type=class|[[Cipher Nine|Imperial Agent]]|Frigid Expedition|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>

During the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire conquest|attack]] on known space, Saganu brokered the deal between [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Arcann]] and the Ascendancy. His cool-headed negotiation tactics helping the Chiss to retain the majority of their worlds in exchange for large production resources for the [[Eternal Fleet]]. His agreement earned him a promotion to [[supreme commander of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]], with him overseeing all of the Chiss's military campaigns.<ref name="Codex" />
[[File:Saganu_on_Odessen.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Saganu on Odessen, addressing the Alliance Commander]]
After the Eternal Empire's [[War against Zakuul|defeat]], Aristocra Saganu contacted the Alliance's [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] offering information regarding [[Theron Shan]], a recent supposed traitor of the Alliance. He assisted the Commander in locating Theron Shan on the Chiss world of [[Copero/Legends|Copero]], providing the Commander with political immunity whilst on the [[Mission to Copero|operation]], due to Theron Shan's association with a traitor to the Ascendancy, [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Zenta]]. During the operation, Saganu offered the Commander the services of the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] in exchange for the death of [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Zenta]].<ref name="A Traitor Among the Chiss">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=flashpoint|A Traitor Among the Chiss}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Saganu can be romanced if the Agent is female. If the Agent is of the Chiss species, he will have additional dialogue options in conversations with Saganu and also be made a [[Merit adoptive/Legends|merit adoptive]] of House Miurani.<ref name="Frigid Expedition" />
